message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jsoncpp && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/test_lib_json/fuzz.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data,size","code":"if (size < sizeof(uint32_t)) return 0;","note":"The fuzzer input is attacker-controlled and must be at least 4 bytes before parsing begins.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/test_lib_json/fuzz.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":25,"var":"data","code":"data += sizeof(uint32_t);","note":"The first 4 bytes are consumed as settings, so the remaining bytes become the JSON document passed to the parser.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input buffer"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/test_lib_json/fuzz.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data_str,size","code":"reader->parse(data_str, data_str + size, &root, nullptr);","note":"The parser is invoked with an end pointer computed from the original size, not the shortened JSON payload length after the settings prefix is removed.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"pointer arithmetic"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp","function":"OurReader::parse","line":1025,"var":"beginDoc,endDoc","code":"bool OurReader::parse(const char* beginDoc, const char* endDoc, Value& root, bool collectComments)","note":"The parser stores the attacker-controlled begin/end pointers and proceeds to read tokens from the supplied range.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"call arguments"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp","function":"OurReader::decodeString","line":1650,"var":"token.end_-token.start_-2","code":"decoded.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(token.end_ - token.start_ - 2));","note":"String decoding sizes internal buffers from token boundaries derived from the malformed range, so an incorrect end pointer can skew the parser's length reasoning.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"tokenization"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp","function":"OurReader::decodeUnicodeCodePoint","line":1738,"var":"current,end","code":"if (end - current < 6) return addError(...);","note":"Unicode escape handling performs explicit bounds checks against the supplied end pointer; with the off-by-one length bug, the parser can advance into the heap buffer past the intended JSON payload.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"incorrect end pointer"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp","function":"OurReader::decodeUnicodeEscapeSequence","line":1758,"var":"*current++","code":"Char c = *current++;","note":"The sink is a byte-by-byte read from the parser cursor; when the cursor is allowed to run one byte past the allocated input, this becomes the heap buffer overflow described in the vulnerability report.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"cursor advancement"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jsoncpp/src/test_lib_json/fuzz.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
